gumtree_entries.description: DELETED o2: Undeclared exception!
ADDED i2: Two observers built for different directories are not considered equal: one is built via the Builder for path "Y0", the other directly for "".
ADDED i3: An observer built from a File and an observer built from a String (with a file filter) target different directories and are therefore not equal.
ADDED i4: Removing a listener that was never added is a harmless no-op.
ADDED i5: Removing a null listener is silently ignored.
ADDED i6: After initialize(), checkAndNotify() can be invoked on an observer built around a shared root FileEntry and an AndFileFilter without error.
ADDED i7: Build a second observer that reuses the same root entry, filtering by age.
ADDED i8: Initializing and then checking the current directory "." completes normally.
ADDED i9: checkAndNotify() works when the observer is created with a null file filter.
ADDED i10: A FileEntry whose children list contains itself causes infinite recursion during checkAndNotify(), surfacing as a StackOverflowError.
ADDED i11: Make the entry its own child so traversal never terminates.
ADDED i13: Initializing and checking an empty directory completes normally.
ADDED i14: checkAndNotify() runs without error when a listener is registered and a temp file exists under the observed directory.
ADDED i15: Adding a null listener is silently ignored.
ADDED i16: An observer can be constructed from a String directory name, an age file filter and a case-sensitivity setting.
ADDED i17: Builder.setIOCase() returns the same builder instance to allow chaining.
ADDED i18: Builder.setFileFilter() returns the same builder instance to allow chaining.
ADDED i19: getListeners() never returns null, even when no listeners are registered.
ADDED i20: checkAndNotify() can be called repeatedly, including after the observed directory is created on the (virtual) file system.
ADDED i21: When no filter is supplied, getFileFilter() defaults to TrueFileFilter.
ADDED i22: destroy() completes without error (it is a no-op in the base class).
ADDED i23: getComparator() always returns a non-null comparator.
ADDED i24: toString() reports the observed directory, filter and listener count.
